response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_avg FROM telescope_averages), filtered_telescopes AS (SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_modindex, oa.overall_avg, ta.avg_modindex - oa.overall_avg as exceeds_by, ta.avg_modindex / oa.overall_avg as ratio_to_overall FROM telescope_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg) SELECT telescref, avg_modindex, exceeds_by, ratio_to_overall FROM filtered_telescopes ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10
